matching.title: Signature network and query provenance
matching.detail: The RPC network comes from the request or the claimed message domain. An independent provider snapshot is not bound to this signing origin or request; a match does not prove the signing network.

matching.title: Signature validity and future consumption remain unverified
matching.detail: Only an unsigned message is available. No signature was requested or generated, and no ecrecover, ERC-1271 isValidSignature, or Permit consumption was performed. Encoding and nonce/domain matches do not prove acceptance or safe future use.

matching.title: Declared signature authority identified
matching.detail: The standard signature commits to a spender and amount cap or NFT identifier, not the final recipient. A zero cap or zero NFT spender expresses a revocation under standard semantics. Implementation and signature validity remain unverified. A Permit2 single-transfer spender can choose an amount within the cap.

matching.title: Signing account code observed
matching.detail: No account code was observed at this block. This does not prove private-key control or exclude an undeployed smart account or future delegation.

matching.title: Verifier code observation
matching.detail: Code is observed only on the stated network and block. Code presence does not establish protocol identity, standard behavior, or safety.

matching.title: Typed-message domain separator comparison
matching.detail: The message domain hash matches the contract return value. This does not establish contract trust or actual signature validity.

matching.title: Declared asset owner compared with signing account
matching.detail: This compares the committed owner, DAI holder or ERC-3009 payer with the signing account. It is not cryptographic signature verification. A difference requires review of the authority and any contract-account extension.

matching.title: Signature submission deadline compared with block time
matching.detail: Only the observed block time and signature deadline are compared. Future submission time, allowance expiration, and actual consumption are separate questions.

matching.title: Permit nonce matched
matching.detail: A nonce match at a fixed block does not guarantee future validity or replace signature verification.

watch.message: Legacy read cycle complete for watched accounts, standard logs and selected tokens only.

alerts.title: Observed outgoing-asset event
alerts.detail: Observed chain logs do not establish maliciousness or all asset changes; verify whether the action was intended.

alerts.title: Native balance decreased
alerts.detail: The change can include gas, transfers and calls; a balance decrease alone does not establish an attack.

alerts.title: Watched token balance decreased
alerts.detail: The watched balance decreased; ordinary spending, delegated use and unexpected use need review.
